data.one_liner: Detect and decode the character encoding of text bytes automatically.
data.what_it_does: It automatically analyzes raw text bytes of unknown character sets and decodes them into readable strings. The package relies on native Mozilla universal charset detection libraries across platforms.
use_when: You need to read text files with unknown or mixed encodings.
You are handling raw bytes from network requests or file inputs where the charset is not specified.
avoid_when: You already know the exact charset of the text bytes you are trying to decode.
You only need standard UTF-8 parsing.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
Automatically determines character sets using proven Mozilla-derived libraries.
weaknesses: Detection accuracy depends on the underlying native libraries and input size.
Detectable charsets differ slightly between platforms.
data.setup_notes: Web requires TextDecoder support. Other platforms require no special setup.
